use: plantAt: place each plant at those places (one floor plant at most). foreground: the near-camera piece of the shots. groups: build every listed group (a few pieces under one group name, at the place named) and make each the subject of one tour shot; the hero group counts as the first. accent: new Home({ accent: hex }); accentOn: put params { tone: 'accent' } on that textile. Soft things: a.seatSoft(id, { tone }), a.table(id, { cloth: true }). still: put each thing on its top with a.onTop; wallArr: hang it on the longest bare wall stretch. side: the hero group sits on that side of the home view. See compose.mjs. motion: a.alive(roll.areas[id].motion) in the spec; see src/motion/index.js.
